fit_reason: Whole 2024 Ford F-150 pickup listed by a private seller on Facebook Marketplace.

message: Hi, we saw your listing for the F-150. The truck already looks sharp, with clean white paint and dark black trim in your photos. If you want the inside freshened up before buyers come by, we do a mobile interior detail that comes to you. Would you like a quote?
